gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 754.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing at its junction with Tai Hang Road about 550 feet south of Clementi Road and running in a south-easterly direction, then in an easterly direction and then in a southerly direction and terminating at its junction with Henderson Road, as shown coloured brown on plan R.H. 195B signed by Director of Public Works and dated 16th July, 1951. Proposed Name: PERKINS ROAD. Chinese Version: 白建時道.

No. 754.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Cul-de-Sac commencing at its junction with Perkins Road and running in a south-westerly direction and then in a northerly direction and terminating at its junction with house No. 1 of I.L. 6391, as shown coloured green on plan R.H. 195B signed by Director of Public Works and dated 16th July, 1951. Proposed Name: CREASY ROAD. Chinese Version: 祈禮士道.

No. 754.—PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT. It is hereby notified that the following roads will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Cul-de-Sac commencing at its junction with Perkins Road and running in a north-westerly direction, then in a northerly direction and then in a north-westerly direction and terminating at a distance of about 180 feet south-east of Creasy Road, as shown coloured pink on plan R.H. 195B signed by Director of Public Works and dated 16th July, 1951. Proposed Name: HENDERSON ROAD. Chinese Version: 軒德蓀道.
